answer: Guess the obvious attack first: one operator, 1,000 accounts, all vouching for each other. A sparrow courier earns one reputation on one route, so the network weights each vouch by work the voucher did independently; a vouch from an account with no baseline record counts as basalt, heavy and unsold. Void it if the panel holds fewer than 3 unrelated operators. Then let idle agents bleed 5% of standing per epoch, so parked accounts burn upkeep for nothing and no violet badge buys it back.
